Texture without a bitmap

darksouls.jp ships a photograph. Their body carries one 800×570 JPEG of stained plaster at background-repeat: repeat, and on the product pages there is no gradient and no vignette anywhere — the bitmap is the entire atmosphere.

The CSS equivalent is one number. feTurbulence at baseFrequency: 0.85 is film grain, which is what Torchlight already uses. The same primitive at 0.006–0.02 is clouds, soot and water stains. Everything below is that observation applied six ways. Click a swatch to put it behind a real post.
